text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yep, things are going great! Super
smooth, in
fact! My running is slowly
improving too.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If I can keep this up, I know I'll grow into
someone
who can stop countless tears
from being shed with
feng shui!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yawn... But for now, I guess it's time for bed. I'll give it my all tomorrow too.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Huh... this is... a dream? Some kind of
vision? It's
the color black again?)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(No, this is different. There's also white.
Are the
two opposites, black and white,
in conflict?)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Such a strange dream. I wonder what it
was
about? Two magatama beads of
contrasting
colors entwined together...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It was definitely the yin and yang
symbol, but
what was it trying to tell
me?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Black and white. Will I have to choose
one or the
other?

text_block_list.name: Rickey and Dia
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later that day, Copano Rickey is doing
some
partner running with Satono
Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... You're so fast Rickey, even though we're running on turf, which is supposed to be my specialty.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Haha, well you know... I debuted earlier, so I do have a little more experience. ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It may not come to me as clearly as the
voice of
dirt does, but I've started to
hear the voice of turf
too. ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Something comes to mind as I'm
watching her. It's
about time we decide
her next race goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Especially if she's able to hear the turf's
voice,
even just a little—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I arrive at the spectator stands which
overlook
the entire training field...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: S-sure. How can I help you?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, her turf running? Well, judging
from how
she looked just now...
choice_data_list: What did you think watching Rickey run on turf?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'd say she's pretty good on the turf! I
mean, she
gave Dia a real run for her
money just now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey will soon enter her
classic year.
Which means...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It won't be long before the famed
Classic Triple
Crown is upon us. If we're
going to change her
course of
progression, this might be our last

chance.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaat?! The Classic Triple Crown?!
You want
me to take on the biggest of
the turf races?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey's goal is to spread the
word of
feng shui and help people.
choice_data_list: Yeah, it might be worth considering.
Yeah, it might be worth considering.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And realistically, big races reach more
people. I
tell her just that.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I see. You're right. If I'm able to show off
the
power of feng shui at a big venue
like that...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Then my goal of getting everyone to
believe in it
will be realized that much
faster! And if things go
well, I may be
able to reach an even bigger
audience!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If I'm now hearing the turf's voice, then
perhaps
that path is opening up to me.
The unknown is
slowly revealing itself.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Turf and dirt. Light and shadow. Two
contrasting
tracks. In other words...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah! So that's what the black and white
meant!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I just realized... this might be an
opportunity that
I was supposed to
happen upon!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I think we need to rethink the path we
decided on
before my debut.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, will this be our last chance to
make a
decision?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Right. In that case, I'll really have to
think hard.
choice_data_list: Probably. The Satsuki Sho is just around the corner.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Dirt or turf—which path will lead to the
greatest
luck, I wonder!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Hmmmm...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey sits staring at her book
for ages,
but she can't seem to make a
decision.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, okay... I think I'm starting to see
the
answer.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Well, honestly... the odds are pretty
even right
now.
choice_data_list: Which one's better according to feng shui?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Black and white are both evenly
matched, each
with their own strengths
and weaknesses.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It seems that way at first glance, right?
But
depending on how you look at it,
there might be
a way.
choice_data_list: Well, then I can't decide, huh...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: We don't have to see things in only black or white. Our top priority isn't to enter every Classic Triple Crown race, is it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Different racers have different ways of
working
with their trainers and different
combinations of
dreams.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, Copano Rickey and I never
teamed up
with the purpose of aiming
for the Classic Triple
Crown.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If I rush to switch over to turf but fail to
employ
my powers of feng shui, it'd all
be for nothing. I
wouldn't be able to
help anyone.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So, here's my suggestion. How about we
send the
dragon underground for this
one?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Let's hold off on the Satsuki Sho.
And in its
place...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let's enter a major dirt race around the
same
time, to give us an idea of my
aptitude and
ability.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
A thorough, underground recon mission!
Lucky
for us, I know just the race to
choose!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey spreads out the race
schedule on
the table.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The Fukuryu Stakes is a dirt open race
held
around the same time as the Satsuki
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Ryu" means "dragon", so even the name
of the
race fits our goal! I think its
perfect, but what
about you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I give her suggestion some thought. It's
true that
we don't have to go after the
Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We'll let that one pass and instead enter
a race
that'll help us make a better
judgment. I believe
that's our best
option.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yeah! That decides it then! ☆
choice_data_list: Alright, then let's enter the Fukuryu Stakes.
All right, let's enter the Fukuryu Stakes then.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whew. You took me by surprise when
you
suddenly brought up the Classic
Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm sure there's some meaning
behind your
suggestion, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Sorry, did I make you hesitate?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't some random idea, but one with
the
potential to change the future. Yes,
a stepping
stone toward a new flow.
That's why...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
From here on out, please tell me what
you think
and how you feel. Your words
will undoubtedly
save lives in the future!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Don't forget, Trainer, you are also a part of my environment, and you help determine my trajectory!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I also want to believe that my suggestion
had
some deep meaning. And so,
Copano Rickey sets
her eyes on the
Fukuryu Stakes.
